notes: Table Array Microphone (Microflex Advance line). Single RJ45 jack is the only physical I/O connector: it carries Dante/AES67 digital audio (5 channels — 4 independently steerable channels + 1 automix output, 48kHz/24-bit), Shure control data, and Power over Ethernet (PoE Class 0, 4W max) all on one cable — there is no separate power inlet, no USB, and no analog audio output on this model. Spec page states Dante audio/control "requires a wired, gigabit Ethernet connection to operate," and the onboard network-speed LED (off=10/100Mbps, on=1Gbps) confirms Gigabit capability, hence grade eth-1g. Desktop tabletop unit, 3.6 x 13.4 x 13.4 cm (H x W x D), 362g — not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Touch-sensitive mute buttons and a recessed reset button are physical controls, not signal/power connectors, so not listed as ports.
